meta.title: Native Collaboration Bundle
meta.description: Manage subagent settings, communication enhancements, Team model selection, and automatic wake-up limit. Changes save automatically.

collabUi.exchange.title: Team / Subagent identity exchange
collabUi.exchange.scope: Only direct, idle, and continuable child sessions under the same Lead can change identity. Session ID, history, model, and working directory stay intact. Running sessions or owners of unfinished tasks are rejected.
collabUi.exchange.protocol: Identity changes are written to canonical Team records. Converted sessions may not be read correctly by older plugin versions or native Team; do not downgrade or disable the plugin and continue operating them directly.
collabUi.exchange.error: Unable to confirm the exchange status. Please retry this operation; an error does not mean an already written identity was rolled back.
collabUi.exchange.empty: No direct child sessions are currently eligible for conversion.
collabUi.exchange.name: Team member name:
collabUi.exchange.recoveryNote: Detected an unconfirmed operation record. You can click to retry; no state changes will be made until you click.
collabUi.exchange.result.unchanged: This operation already completed; no duplicate change.
collabUi.exchange.result.recovery-required: Save result needs verification. Please do not send new messages yet; retry this operation or restore the session first.
collabUi.exchange.notificationFailed: Identity was persisted, but some notifications were not delivered. Please check the parent Agent and Lead.
collabUi.exchange.reason.busy: The session is currently busy or waiting for input. Please retry when it is idle.
collabUi.exchange.reason.transition-in-progress: This session is currently converting. Please retry after it completes.
collabUi.exchange.reason.unfinished-tasks: The member owns unfinished shared tasks. Please release, hand off, or complete them first.
collabUi.exchange.reason.invalid-request: Invalid request parameters. Please check the member name and retry.
collabUi.exchange.reason.unavailable: The collaboration runtime or session is currently unavailable.
collabUi.exchange.reason.not-found: Target is outside the eligible scope. Refresh the list.
collabUi.exchange.reason.inconsistent-state: The session state or record is abnormal; conversion is unsafe until restored.
collabUi.exchange.reason.rejected: The current session state or hierarchy does not allow this exchange.

collabUi.capabilityImpact: Child-agent communication and Team enhancements can be enabled separately below. Turning enhancements off does not remove message permissions or delete conversation records.
collabUi.lifecycleInstall: After installation, background collaboration services load automatically, and enhancement settings save as you change them. Options requiring a restart take effect after restarting the working profile.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.subagent: This service starts automatically with the plugin management entry; it is not a feature toggle. Adjust enhancements in plugin settings and restart the working profile when required.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.control: This tool loads with the AgentPreset and does not need to be enabled at root. It is available in conversations.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.listAgents: This tool loads with the AgentPreset and does not need to be enabled at root. It is available in conversations.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.agentTeam: This service starts automatically with the plugin management entry; it is not a feature toggle. Adjust enhancements in plugin settings and restart the working profile when required.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.teamTools: This service starts automatically with the plugin management entry; it is not a feature toggle. Adjust enhancements in plugin settings and restart the working profile when required.
collabUi.lifecycleRemove: Wait for running tasks to finish, then disable or uninstall the plugin and restart the current working profile. If it no longer starts after uninstalling or after a failed uninstall, follow the project FAQ and the plugin notes to recover manually: inspect the external startup override files in the Profile directory, then remove or correct them as described and start again.
collabUi.lifecycleSidecar: Uninstalling the plugin does not delete conversations or logs. The consecutive automatic wake-up counter lives in memory and resets on restart.

collabUi.settingsSummary: Subagent settings, communication enhancements, Team model selection, and automatic wake-up limit
collabUi.settingsScope: Settings save automatically after modification. Subagent runtime limits synchronize directly with the native DSH configuration. Model source applies to subsequent child Agent and Team creation; restart-required options take effect after restarting the working profile.
collabUi.restartRequired: Settings saved. Options requiring a restart take effect after restarting the working profile, without interrupting ongoing chats.
collabUi.modelSourceConversation: Model list captured when the conversation started (native setting)
collabUi.modelSourceSettings: Child-model list configured in current DSH settings
collabUi.modelSourceAll: All models currently available in the DSH environment
collabUi.autoSaveDescription: Changes save automatically; status and notifications appear beside the affected section without needing a manual save button.
collabUi.nativeCompatNote: This only changes how candidate models are listed, without granting access to unauthorized models; this setting also applies to ordinary child Agents.
collabUi.communicationOffNote: Turning enhancements off does not affect native messaging or interrupt running tasks.
collabUi.quotaRemains: Default limit is 32 consecutive automatic wake rounds, shared by all Agents associated with the session. Only uninterrupted automatic cross-session wake-ups and messages without user input are counted. Any human input in a related session resets the count. Completion and stop reports to the direct parent or Lead are exempt. The counter is in memory and resets on process restart.

collabUi.progressEntry: How to view progress and results
collabUi.progressTeam: Team tasks: return to the originating conversation and open Team at the top to view member status, messages, and shared tasks; select a member to open its conversation.
collabUi.progressChild: Independent child Agents: open the child Agent task card in the originating conversation to view execution status and results.
collabUi.progressAction: To provide additional instructions, return to the originating conversation; to stop work, use that conversation's Stop action. Changing settings on this page does not stop or restart tasks.
collabUi.pendingRestartYes: Some settings are pending a restart of the working profile.
collabUi.modalPresetUnknown: Verify preset tools in an actual chat. This table does not verify external overlays or all presets.
collabUi.teamDescription: More flexible model selection for Team members. The same selection setting also affects ordinary child Agents. It does not grant access to additional models.
collabUi.selectionSnapshot: Use the model list from the conversation start

runtime.title: Current runtime
runtime.nativeNote: Enhanced background services are not attached. Check that the management entry is enabled, save the desired enhancements, and restart this Profile; do not enable internal components individually.
runtime.readyNote: This confirms background services only, not tool availability in all AgentPresets. Verify tools in an actual chat.

failure.ownership-unverified: Runtime assembly conflicts with another component or its inventory is unavailable. Enhanced services were not started. Keep the safe code and review overrides; see the project FAQ for legacy manual configuration rather than toggling internal components.
failure.plugin-start-failed: An enhanced service could not start. Keep the version, affected role, and safe error code. If disabling the plugin, finish tasks first and restart this Profile afterwards.
failure.plugin-cleanup-failed: Service cleanup is unconfirmed. Do not switch or uninstall yet. Verify that this Profile’s host processes have fully stopped and retain redacted diagnostics.
failure.unknown: This service state is unconfirmed. Keep its role and safe error code for diagnosis; do not assume it stopped safely.

limits.title: Subagent runtime limits
limits.help: While this plugin is enabled, native Subagent settings are managed here and directly read/write the host `subagent` configuration. Changes synchronize with original DSH settings, and changes made there also take effect. With recursion depth 0, child Agents cannot create further child Agents; existing multi-level subagents will not be interrupted.
limits.saved: Saved automatically and synchronized with original DSH Subagent settings.
limits.invalid: Depth must be a whole number of 0 or more; concurrency limit must be an integer of 1 or more.
limits.readonly: The native configuration has external overrides or an unconfirmed write target; runtime limits are currently read-only.
limits.unavailable: Subagent settings could not be verified automatically; editing is temporarily locked. Please reopen the settings page to retry.
limits.conflict: Configuration was modified elsewhere; this edit was not saved (your draft is retained). Please reload the page to review the latest settings.
limits.saveFailed: Automatic save could not be confirmed; your draft is retained. Please reload the settings page to check saved values.
